metadata.method: Height Above Nearest Drainage from Copernicus GLO-30 against the OSM channel network (Cheyyeru + Penna), thresholded by stage, kept only where hydraulically connected to the channel, capped at 6 km from the main stem, permanent water masked from OSM polygons.
metadata.reason_not_observed: No satellite observed this flood. Sentinel-1 path 92 is the only footprint over the affected reach and acquired 16 Nov then 28 Nov 2021, so the 19 Nov event falls in a 12-day gap; path 165 flew 21 Nov but its footprint ends ~9 km west of the dam. Sentinel-2 passed 4 h after the breach into 98.7% cloud over the corridor.
metadata.consistency_check: Reported depth ~10 ft (~3 m). All four villages named as submerged fall in the <=5 m corridor at HAND 2.4-4.8 m.
metadata.event: Annamayya dam breach, 19 Nov 2021, Cheyyeru river
